_comment: Settings for the 'New Workstation Baseline' tool (tools/MspSetupWorkstationBaseline.ps1).
Edit this file to match LENET's standard build. Keys starting with '_' are notes and are ignored by the tool.

DefaultTimeZone: Windows time zone ID offered as the default. 'South Africa Standard Time' is only a default for LENET's SA clients - change it per client/site if needed (list IDs with: Get-TimeZone -ListAvailable).

PowerPlan: name of the plan as shown by 'powercfg /list' (e.g. 'Balanced', 'High performance') or its GUID. Balanced = 381b4222-f694-41f0-9685-ff5bb260df2e (default here - a GUID works on any Windows display language; plan names are localized).
ComputerNamePattern: a hint shown when renaming (e.g. 'CLIENT-SERIAL' means client code + serial number). Only a suggestion; the tech always types the name. Leave empty for no hint.

RemoveApps: consumer AppX package names to offer for removal. Wildcards (*) are allowed, e.g. 'king.com.*'. The tech still picks which ones to remove on each machine. The tool refuses to remove core apps (Store, Photos, Calculator, Notepad, Terminal, Snipping Tool, Paint, Teams, Outlook, frameworks) even if listed here.
RemoveAppsOptional: NOT used by the tool - apps some MSPs remove but that users may rely on. Move an entry into RemoveApps to enable it.
InstallApps: winget package IDs (exact, case-insensitive) installed silently. THIS IS AN EXAMPLE LIST - replace it with LENET's standard software list. Find IDs with: winget search <name>.
_RemoveAppsOptional_notes: ZuneMusic is the Windows 11 Media Player; XboxGamingOverlay is Game Bar (Win+G screen recording); XboxIdentityProvider is needed for Xbox/Store game sign-in; GetHelp replaces the legacy troubleshooters on Windows 11; windowscommunicationsapps is the old Mail and Calendar app; OfficeHub is the 'Microsoft 365 (Office)' launcher.
